display.purpose: The name, once per page; the job title beneath it at the same size in weight 500 and Grey.

title.purpose: Project titles in the index, and the closing email link.

body.purpose: Everything that is read: bio, descriptions, row content, side headings (weight 500). Paragraphs capped at 54ch.

label.purpose: Metadata: dates, kinds, tool lists, navigation, the Sample marker, the footer.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for the load draw, the settle, the link underline and the project entry opening.

motion.name: draw
motion.value: scaleX(0) to 1 from the left, 0.9s, once on load
motion.purpose: Section and footer rules draw in. Only without prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: opacity 0.4 to 1 and translateY(10px) to 0, 0.8s, second block delayed 120ms
motion.purpose: Hero text settles as the rules draw. Only without prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: Underline draws from the left on hover and keyboard focus.

motion.name: entry-open
motion.purpose: Project entry eases open where ::details-content is supported. Only without prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: plus-turn
motion.purpose: The plus on a project entry turns to a cross when open.

narrative.overview:
The page is the document a recruiter already reads every day, a résumé, set with a typographer's care. It is one sheet of paper in one grotesk: side headings in a left column, content in ruled rows on the right, a name and two sentences at the top. Nothing sits on a surface above the page, because there is only the page.

The system is monochrome and minimalist by the owner's binding commitment. Hierarchy comes from four type sizes, three weights and the difference between ink and grey. Separation comes from hairline rules. Motion happens in two places only: the sheet's rules draw in from the left once on load, and links draw their underline on hover.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface, four sizes, three weights (400, 500, 600).
Ink, grey, paper and a hairline; no hue anywhere.
Side headings left, ruled rows right, inside a 1040px sheet.
Flat: no cards, no shadows, no filled panels around content.
One project open at a time.
Placeholder content is marked as a sample wherever it appears.

rules.name: The Ink Only Rule
rules.body: No hue. Emphasis is ink against grey, weight, or size, never a colour. A link is ink with an underline that draws in, not a coloured word.

rules.name: The Four Sizes Rule
rules.body: 14, 18, the title clamp and the name clamp. A fifth size is not available; rank within a size is carried by weight (500 against 400) and by ink against grey.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Years, dates and counts use tabular numerals so they align down a column of rows.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Content is separated by a 1px line, never by a box. Rows carry a line beneath (none under the last); each section carries a line above; the project index opens with the one ink-coloured line on the page.

rules.name: The One Open Rule
rules.body: In the project index exactly one entry is expanded at a time; opening another closes it.

rules.name: The Marked Sample Rule
rules.body: Placeholder content is never shown unmarked. If it is not real, the group heading says "Sample".

dos: Do set every surface in Schibsted Grotesk at one of the four sizes: 14px, 18px, the title clamp (24px to 36px) or the name clamp (40px to 56px).
Do separate content with 1px hairline rules and whitespace.
Do keep content inside the 1040px sheet, with side headings in the 200px column and secondary detail in the 232px right column.
Do put load animation, smooth scrolling and eased opening behind the reduced-motion check.
Do give links and navigation items a 44px minimum height and the 2px ink focus outline.
Do mark placeholder content with the Sample marker.
donts: Don't introduce a hue, a tint or a gradient; the palette is ink, grey, paper and hairline.
Don't wrap content in cards, panels or shadows.
Don't add a fifth type size or a second typeface.
Don't add icons beyond the arrow and the plus.
Don't let more than one project entry stay open.
Don't add motion beyond the rules drawing in on load, the underline drawing on hover, and the entry easing open.
